name: Ulquiorra Mono Spirit

members.name: Ulquiorra Shifar
notes: Prep part of Segunda Etapa before using Aizen's Ultimate

members.name: Sosuke Aizen
notes: Maintain Ravage stacks while giving Ulquiorra as much field time as possible

members.name: Szayelaporro Granz
notes: The only limited SSR Spirit support as of now

rotationP2W: Szayelaporro technique → Ulquiorra technique → Battlefield → Manual counter → Aizen technique → Battlefield → Szayelaporro counter → Ultimate → Ulquiorra counter → Ulquiorra technique → Dodge → Basic attacks → Ulquiorra technique → Dodge → Ulquiorra Special Attack → Cero Oscuras → Ultimate
rotationF2P: Sub Momo for Szayelaporro — Momo plays the same role as Szayelaporro

p2w-rotations.name: B6W5C5
steps: In Segunda Etapa, use technique into basic attack to refresh, then technique once again before swapping out to Aizen using battlefield
Aizen Technique combo (finish it completely) → Battlefield (3 Pressure Stacks before using) → Ultimate
Counter with Szayelaporro → Ultimate → Technique → Counter with Ulquiorra → Technique → 1 basic attack → Swap to Aizen
Aizen basic attack OR technique (if it's available) → Hado 90: Kurohitsugi → Szayelaporro counter → Ulquiorra counter
Ulquiorra technique → Enhanced technique → Technique 2-4 → Ultimate → Technique spam → Ultimate → Aizen Battlefield
p2w-rotations.notes: This is only one way to start the rotation. There are many others, find the one that suits you best.

p2w-rotations.name: Momo Swap
steps: Momo Technique → Special attack x2 → Ulquiorra technique
Battlefield → Technique (complete combo) → Battlefield → Momo counter → Momo Ultimate
Ulquiorra counter → Technique → Dodge → Basic attack to refresh Technique → Technique → Dodge → Special Attack → Cero Oscuras
Ulquiorra Ultimate → Technique → Basic attack to refresh Technique → Technique → Battlefield
p2w-rotations.notes: Momo as a SR unit can replace Szayelaporro. Ulquiorra and Aizen remain required SSRs.

steps: Szayelaporro: Technique → swap to Ulquiorra
Ulquiorra: Technique
Sosuke: Technique 3 → Counter → Technique x2 → BFS
Ulquiorra: Repeat Step 01
p2w-rotations.notes: Opener only: Ulquiorra should not need a rebuild at this tier. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.

steps: Szayelaporro: Technique → swap to Ulquiorra
Ulquiorra: Technique

Szayelaporro: Counter → Ultimate → swap to Ulquiorra → Counter

p2w-rotations.name: Ulquiorra Mono Spirit — Sajin Komamura
steps: Szayelaporro: Counter → Technique → swap to Ulquiorra

steps: Szayelaporro: Technique → swap to Ulquiorra

p2w-rotations.name: Ulquiorra Mono Spirit — Events
steps: Szayelaporro: Technique → swap to Ulquiorra
Ulquiorra: Technique
Ulquiorra: Technique 2 → Basic Attack 2 x3 → Technique 2
Ulquiorra: Technique 2 → Basic Attack 2 → swap to Sosuke
p2w-rotations.notes: A closed loop with no opener and no Ultimate dump, so it holds up after the burst routes run dry. Bank Ulquiorra's Ultimate for whatever window the stage gives you. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.

p2w-rotations.name: Ulquiorra Mono Spirit — Frenzy Feast
steps: Szayelaporro: Technique → swap to Ulquiorra
Ulquiorra: Technique
Sosuke: Technique 3 → Counter → Technique x2 → BFS
Szayelaporro: Counter → Ultimate → swap to Ulquiorra → Counter
p2w-rotations.notes: Front-loads every buff so Ulquiorra swings inside the full window — no second cycle, which is the trade a timed score push wants. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.
